summary: This is a targeted fix for a TypeScript build error in app/api/item-listing-crud/route.ts, where the sort comparator indexes the item object with a plain string-typed 'sort' variable. The fix asserts 'sort' as a valid key of the item type (or uses a typed key union) before indexing, so the comparator type-checks. No other files or scope changes are needed since this is a revision to an already-implemented and verified feature.

files.rationale: Fix TypeScript type error at the sort comparator by typing 'sort' as a key of the item shape (e.g. `keyof typeof item` or an explicit union type like 'name' | 'price' | 'quantity' | 'category' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt') and casting/validating the incoming sort parameter against that union before using it to index items in a[sort]/b[sort], so both the if-branch and else-branch comparator lines type-check cleanly.
